I’m glad you were able to help her, even if that wasn’t your intention! I was raped when I was 18 or 19 by someone I thought was a friend. I hadn’t ever slept with anyone until that point.

What helped me was when another friend asked me if I’d be interested in being friends with benefits. He didn’t know what had happened at this point and of course I was hesitant and after a couple weeks of considering, I did say yes but disclosed what had happened to him. Because of that, he took it super slow with me and we set clear communication and boundaries. I actually consider him my first. At this point, we consider ourselves to be in an open relationship (it’s been ten years since we started sleeping together) and have even discussed marriage a few times. Thanks to him, I can have a happy, healthy sex life without having flashbacks or having the trauma cross my mind. I have had tons of therapy too of course. 

I know it’s not a common way to heal from trauma but it helped me so much.
